provenance: Hand-authored 2026-08-19 for the CTO-authorized N/A-vs-UNSUPPORTED diagnostic. claim: Company X expects revenue growth next quarter.
evidence: Company X provides no guidance regarding revenue for next quarter.
reference_rationale: Per Document 47 Rev 5 Sec7.3.1: same entity (Company X), same metric (revenue), same period (next quarter) as the claim -- clears relevance unambiguously. Explicit absence disclaimer about that exact proposition -- UNSUPPORTED, not NOT_APPLICABLE. Not ambiguous under the ratified policy. Independently justified from the evidence text alone, assigned before any judge call and never sent to the judge.
